XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Engine warning light comes on, with jerky operation and limited performance
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INJECTION | P0101 | FLOW METER | SENSOR | MASS | AIR | BULB | YIELDS | LOSES | DROPS | LACK | POWER | SPEED | DECLINE | SIGNIFICANT | SIGNIFICANTLY | DRASTIC | DRASTICALLY | LIGHTS UP | LIT | MIL | YELLOW |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: Air flow sensor

  • Fault: Significant drop in performance with engine fault light illuminated

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system: P0101 (Mass Air Flow Sensor - Incorrect set point)

  • Cause: Faulty mass air flow sensor

• Action: Check the condition and correct operation of the air flow meter and, if necessary, replace it.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The component is located above the gearbox, in the engine compartment, on the driver’s side.

    The estimated time for the procedure is approximately 0.7 hours.
